nodes.label: DEC-005 deceptive-but-safe honeypot
nodes.rationale: Genuinely draining exploits would revert attacker frames and destroy the observability the Analysis Agent depends on, so contracts present a classic reentrancy bait but keep funds safe via checks-effects-interactions while emitting durable telemetry.

nodes.label: Security model and approval gates
nodes.rationale: Autonomous actions (monitor, analyze, deploy to local/devnet) are allowed; mainnet or fund-moving actions require human approval to prevent harm and key exposure.

nodes.label: shadcn/ui Not Adopted for MVP
nodes.rationale: Keep dependency surface minimal; consistent with the project's direct-library approach. shadcn can be layered later without changing the data layer.

nodes.label: DEC-003: Prisma 7 with Driver Adapter
nodes.rationale: Version alignment prevents runtime/generator drift; adapter mode matches upstream's current architecture.

nodes.label: DEC-005: Deceptive-but-Safe Honeypot Templates
nodes.rationale: Product value = observed attacker behavior, requiring non-reverting persistent signals; zero real-value risk aligns with security model.

nodes.label: DEC-004: Local Postgres via Rootless Podman
nodes.norm_label: dec-004: local postgres via rootless podman
nodes.rationale: No system service changes or root required; matches local-dev target of plan §17.

nodes.label: SQLite limitations (no enums, no scalar lists, write lock)
nodes.norm_label: sqlite limitations (no enums, no scalar lists, write lock)

nodes.label: pnpm workspace configuration (hive-trace)
nodes.rationale: pnpm workspace config that excludes @next/* and next from the minimumReleaseAge safety check, allowing immediate updates of the Next.js framework within the workspace.

nodes.label: Apple touch icon — iOS home-screen favicon
nodes.norm_label: apple touch icon — ios home-screen favicon
nodes.rationale: iOS apple-touch-icon used when the hive-trace web app is added to a home screen; square app brand mark.

nodes.label: Primary app icon (vector, color-adaptive)
nodes.rationale: Primary vector app icon (180x180, rounded); monochrome H/hexagon-style mark that inverts fill via prefers-color-scheme for light/dark.

nodes.label: Dark-theme favicon (32x32 raster)
nodes.rationale: Small raster favicon variant for dark UI themes; brand mark in a dark-mode-friendly color.

nodes.label: Light-theme favicon (32x32 raster)
nodes.rationale: Small raster favicon variant for light UI themes; brand mark in a light-mode-friendly color.

nodes.label: Generic placeholder image
nodes.rationale: Generic photo placeholder (image-with-mountain/landscape motif) for empty media slots in the UI.

nodes.label: Placeholder brand logo (raster)
nodes.rationale: Generic placeholder brand wordmark used in UI where a real company/product logo is absent.

nodes.label: Placeholder brand logo (vector)
nodes.rationale: Vector version of the placeholder brand wordmark for crisp scaling in the UI.

nodes.label: Placeholder user avatar
nodes.rationale: Default profile/avatar image shown when a user has no uploaded photo.

nodes.label: File/document icon (Next.js template)
nodes.rationale: Default Next.js create-next-app UI glyph representing a document/file; boilerplate template asset.

nodes.label: Globe icon (Next.js template)
nodes.rationale: Default Next.js template glyph representing global/external navigation; boilerplate template asset.

nodes.label: Vercel logo
nodes.rationale: Vercel triangle logo; boilerplate deployment-platform branding asset from create-next-app.

nodes.label: Window/browser-chrome icon (Next.js template)
nodes.rationale: Default Next.js template glyph representing a browser window/app frame; boilerplate template asset.

nodes.label: adapter constructor option (required for SQL workflow)
nodes.norm_label: adapter constructor option (required for sql workflow)

nodes.label: Deployment permission gate (MAINNET_DEPLOY_APPROVED)
nodes.rationale: Enforce plan §7/§17: any non-local (testnet/mainnet) deploy is rejected with DeploymentRejectedError unless MAINNET_DEPLOY_APPROVED=true or approved:true, preventing unapproved remote deploys.

nodes.label: Project converted to ESM
nodes.rationale: Hardhat 3.14 + toolbox pushed the project to ESM ("type":"module", DEC-006); node-side scripts must be ESM; Next tsconfig/eslint scoped away from generated/contract-test code.

nodes.label: Deploy guard: localhost defaults to well-known dev account
nodes.norm_label: deploy guard: localhost defaults to well-known dev account
nodes.rationale: Non-local RPC requires explicit DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY; localhost uses the well-known Hardhat dev account to keep local dev frictionless.

nodes.label: MVP loop: detect attack → AI analysis → DB report → dashboard
nodes.norm_label: mvp loop: detect attack → ai analysis → db report → dashboard
nodes.rationale: Plan §20 MVP DoD; the listener/orchestrator (P6.01) closes the autonomous loop tying deployment, analysis, and DB together.

nodes.label: Prisma CLI pinned to stable v7
nodes.norm_label: prisma cli pinned to stable v7
nodes.rationale: 8.0 RC was rejected; stable v7 chosen for reliability of the ORM/DB tooling.

nodes.label: Testnet keys must use Hardhat keystore (no plaintext)
nodes.norm_label: testnet keys must use hardhat keystore (no plaintext)
nodes.rationale: Sepolia intentionally left unconfigured; future testnet keys must use Hardhat keystore/configVariable() rather than plaintext secrets.

nodes.label: Decision: shadcn/ui deliberately not adopted
nodes.rationale: Keep a minimal dependency surface; project hand-rolls a small set of components instead of pulling in the shadcn/ui toolkit (documented in docs/09).

nodes.label: Zod promoted to a direct dependency
nodes.norm_label: zod promoted to a direct dependency
nodes.rationale: Plan §12 specifies Zod as the validator; standard-lib cannot validate; Zod is maintained, permissively licensed, zero extra runtime cost (documented in docs/22).

nodes.label: Roadmap as directional (TBD placeholders)
nodes.rationale: Completed/Current/Next/Future sections are placeholders (TBD); roadmap items are directional until converted into prioritized requirements/tasks.

nodes.label: Documentation authority structure
nodes.rationale: Requirements live in 01, scope in 02, tech decisions in 03 and 30, dev rules in 11/13/24, completion criteria in 28; single source of truth per concern to avoid duplication.

nodes.label: Documentation reading order
nodes.rationale: Canonical onboarding sequence: 00→01→02→03→04 then task-specific docs.
